_about: Third set of hand-written test texts, written 2026-11-11 BEFORE the patterns were changed that day, so it is the honest score for that change. Do not add patterns based on these; write a new set instead.
texts: Hey any news on the Highlander?
did yall get a chance to work on my truck yet
Wondering if my car will be ready by 5
what's the latest on my van
Is the brake job on my Escape done
just checking on my car, thanks
how is my moms Buick coming along
When do you think it'll be finished?
Have the parts shown up yet?
Is my truck still waiting on parts
u guys done w my car
Hi, it's Karen. Is my Camry ready to be picked up?
What time do you open Monday?
Are you guys open on Veterans Day?
What time do you close on Fridays?
Can you send me that estimate link again
I can't open the link you sent
Where do I see the quote?
Can you resend the page so I can approve
Yes please do the alignment too
Just do the oil change, skip the rest
Let's hold off on the tires
Is it ready and how much do I owe
Can I pick it up at 4:30?
Is it safe to drive to work tomorrow?
Can I bring it in Thursday?
Why is it taking so long?
Can you also check my wipers
I need it back by tonight or I can't get to work
My husband will pick it up
Do I really need the timing belt done?
the car is pulling to the left after you guys worked on it
Can I leave the keys in the drop box after hours?
Is my car done? Also can you check the AC?
